title: An agent's definition
description: The body of PUT /v1/agents/{org}/{user}/{name}, and of GET /v1/agents/{org}/{user}/{name}/definition where the server keeps definitions. An agent file's frontmatter takes the same keys, with its body as instructions, and name, org, user, schedule and notify besides.

description.description: What the agent is for, in words a person reads.

tools.description: What the agent may call: a tool the server ships, by name; server/* for every tool of an MCP server; workers/* for every tool the connected tool workers offer it; or * for all of them.

oneOf.description: A policy the server holds, by name.
Rules, as a policy file writes them.

timeout.description: How many seconds a turn may take.

max_iterations.description: How many rounds of tool calls a turn may make.

compaction.description: When the agent summarises its older history, as shares of the model's window; false never does.
